chunks.arabic_text: ٣ - الْفَتْحُ بْنُ يَزِيدَ، الْجُرْجَانِيُّ، صَاحِبُ " الْمَسَائِلِ لِأَبِي الْحَسَنِ (عليه السلام) "، وَاخْتَلَفُوا أَنَّهُ هُوَ الرِّضَا (عليه السلام) أَوِ الثَّالِثُ (عليه السلام)؟ وَالرَّجُلُ مَجْهُولٌ، وَالْإِسْنَادُ إِلَيْهِ مَدْخُولٌ.

translations.en: 3 – Al-Fath ibn Yazid, al-Jurjani, the possessor of "al-Masā'il li-Abī al-Ḥasan (peace be upon him)", and they differ as to whether he is al-Riḍā (peace be upon him) or the Third (peace be upon him)? The man is unknown, and the isnād to him is unsound.

en.summary: Al-Ghadā'irī highlights the ambiguity surrounding Al-Fath ibn Yazīd al-Jurjānī, whose authorship of 'al-Masā'il' links him to either Imam al-Riḍā or Imam al-Jawād, reflecting the complex transmission of hadith during the transition between these two Imams. His classification as 'majhūl' (unknown) and the 'madkhlūn' (interpolated) nature of his chain underscore the rigorous scrutiny applied to narrators in Shia hadith sciences to ensure the authenticity of prophetic and imamic traditions.
en.seo_question: Who is Al-Fath ibn Yazid al-Jurjani and what is the status of his narration in Shia hadith sciences?

key_terms.الْمَسَائِلِ: al-Masā'il (The Questions/Issues, a title of a hadith collection)
key_terms.أَبِي الْحَسَنِ: Abī al-Ḥasan (Abu al-Hasan, a title used for several Imams)
key_terms.الثَّالِثُ: al-Thālith (The Third, referring to the 3rd Imam or potentially the 9th depending on context, here likely contrasting with the 8th)
key_terms.مَجْهُولٌ: Majhūl (Unknown, a technical term in 'Ilm al-Rijal for a narrator whose identity or reliability is not clearly established)
key_terms.مَدْخُولٌ: Madkhlūn (Flawed/Interpolated, indicating a defect in the chain of transmission)
